name: C5-3 RLHF: reward model scores two candidate answers
description: An untrained reward head scores two answers

params.label: r(chosen) — should exceed r(rejected) after RLHF training
r(rejected) — pushed down by Bradley-Terry loss

data.noteContent:
A reward model is the piece of RLHF that turns 'people preferred this answer' into a number a policy can be optimised against. RewardModel is that head: a hidden state in, one scalar out. The two TensorInputs stand in for the last hidden states of two answers to the same prompt, the chosen one and the rejected one. Nothing here is trained, so the two scores are an accident of the seeds: as shipped the rejected answer gets 0.177 and the chosen one 0.041. Training on preference pairs is what would put them the other way round.

獎勵模型負責把「人比較喜歡這個回答」變成一個可以拿來最佳化的數字，RewardModel 就是那顆頭：吃一個隱藏狀態，吐一個純量。兩個 TensorInput 代表同一個提示下兩份回答的最後隱藏狀態，一份被選中、一份被拒絕。這裡沒有任何訓練，所以兩個分數只是種子決定的：照目前的設定，被拒絕的那份拿到 0.177，被選中的只有 0.041。要把順序換回來，得拿偏好配對去訓練。

Both RewardModel nodes are built from seed 42 with the same dimensions, so they hold identical weights. This is one reward model scoring two answers, not two models competing; there are two nodes only because each takes its own input.

兩個 RewardModel 都用 seed 42 和相同維度建出來，權重完全一樣。這是同一個獎勵模型評兩份回答，不是兩個模型在比；會有兩個節點，只是因為各自吃自己的輸入。

Training compares the pair, not the two numbers on their own: the Bradley-Terry loss is -log sigmoid(r(chosen) - r(rejected)), so only the difference counts and adding a constant to both changes nothing. BradleyTerryLoss in the RL palette takes these two scores directly.

訓練時比的是這一對，不是兩個數字各自的大小：Bradley-Terry 損失是 -log sigmoid(r(chosen) - r(rejected))，只有差值算數，兩邊同時加一個常數不會有任何改變。RL 分類裡的 BradleyTerryLoss 節點可以直接吃這兩個分數。
